regions.name: North America
limitations: Experimental western-US calibration applied globally; coverage is not independent validation of accuracy.
Annual 2025 model, not live sky conditions; no terrain shielding, spectrum or weather correction.
The complete 300 km source footprint is required; polar source limits remain unavailable.
Roads, labels and terrain are separate basemap downloads.

Globally, a source pixel remains lit only where both 2024 and 2025 masked annual radiance are positive. Retained pixels use their original 2025 radiance; no 2024 brightness values are substituted. Missing input coverage remains unavailable. Genuine lights appearing only in 2025 are excluded; artifacts present in both years or extra brightness over existing lights may remain.

source_provenance.rule: Retain original 2025 radiance where both valid years have positive radiance; remove 2025-only positive radiance. No 2024 brightness is substituted.
source_provenance.unknown_coverage: NoData if either input is invalid; never treated as darkness.
limitations: New lights appearing only in 2025 are intentionally excluded.
Artifacts present in both years or extra radiance over a persistent source may remain.
